verdict.rationale: Google Authenticator publishes help-center docs and a GitHub project, so offering llms.txt or agent-oriented documentation is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions an llms.txt file, machine-readable docs, or documentation written for AI agents; every item covers user-facing app features (sync, QR transfer, editing codes) or OTP and PAM implementations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
